2608.07254.title: SCALE: Scientific Concept Aggregation via LLMs and Embeddings for Fine-Grained Taxonomy Extension
2608.07254.paper_summary: The increasing specialization of scientific research challenges existing classification systems, which provide effective representations of broad disciplines and research topics but often fail to capture the fine-grained conceptual structure of contemporary science. Author keywords offer greater specificity, but their fragmentation, redundancy, and terminological variability limit their use as stable units of knowledge organization. We introduce SCALE (Scientific Concept Aggregation via LLMs and Embeddings), a framework that extends the OpenAlex taxonomy with a new level of scientific Concepts below Topics. Rather than treating keywords as isolated descriptors, SCALE organizes semantically related terms into coherent and interpretable conceptual units and integrates them within the existing disciplinary hierarchy. The framework combines scientific text embeddings, large language models, and graph-based community detection to construct this additional layer at scale. The resulting taxonomy enables scientific literature to be read through an intermediate conceptual level between broad research topics and individual documents. This perspective provides a more detailed representation of how scientific knowledge is structured, specialized, and connected across disciplines. By transforming heterogeneous author terminology into reusable hierarchical units, SCALE offers a foundation for fine-grained scholarly classification, scientometric analysis, research monitoring, and future ontology development.
2608.07254.paper_summary_zh: 科學研究的日益專業化對現有的分類系統提出了挑戰，這些系統能有效地表示廣泛的學科和研究主題，但往往無法捕捉當代科學的細緻概念結構。作者關鍵詞提供了更大的具體性，但它們的碎片化、冗餘性和術語變異性限制了它們作為穩定知識組織單位的使用。我們介紹了SCALE（通過LLMs和嵌入進行的科學概念聚合），這是一個擴展OpenAlex分類法的框架，新增了一個位於主題下方的科學概念層級。SCALE並不將關鍵詞視為孤立的描述符，而是將語義相關的術語組織成連貫且可解釋的概念單位，並將它們整合進現有的學科層級中。該框架結合了科學文本嵌入、大型語言模型和基於圖的社群檢測，以大規模構建這一額外層級。最終產生的分類法使科學文獻能夠通過廣泛研究主題和個別文檔之間的中介概念層級進行閱讀。這一視角提供了更詳細的科學知識結構、專業化和跨學科聯繫的表示。通過將異質的作者術語轉化為可重用的分層單位，SCALE為細緻的學術分類、科學計量分析、研究監測和未來本體的發展提供了基礎。
